title: DURATION 641/720 and MDURATION 644/720 on a fresh gate, 143 rows open
status_plain: Two per-surface counts on one fresh corpus. Battery b46, described as fresh and month-end-majority, scores DURATION at 641 of 720 and MDURATION at 644 of 720, with every miss within 2 ULP and none material. Both sources give the two numbers separately and label the second MDURATION, which forces the first to be DURATION alone; the identical denominators with numerators three apart is itself the proof that these are two per-surface scores and not one shared corpus. The gate did real work: the earlier pre-registered gate b45 scored 456 of 540 and exposed a month-end accrued-span convention break that the larger b44 corpus could not see, the fix was one line, and b46 is the re-gate. A third figure in the same lane, b44 at 6,217 of 6,360, carries no surface label and is NOT attributed here.

reader_warning: 641/720 is DURATION's and 644/720 is MDURATION's; they are separate per-surface counts on one fresh corpus and neither may be given to the other. b44's 6,217 of 6,360 carries no surface label, cannot be split, and must not be attributed to either surface or summed with b46. DURATION also inherits PRICE's E−A rule on bases 2 and 3 through the shared pcomp, and its own residual is open.
